contract_findings.finding: Observe the missing need from an actual current NEEDS_CAPABILITY row with no invocation/result. Permission, source, semantic payload, input and revision must agree; neither a supplied code hash nor fabricated need is the trigger.

Use the existing deterministic affine producer. Oracle and seven-file source freeze precede candidate construction. Admission performs all 256 trials; exact bytes, oracle, engine/configuration and observed host-owned package origin remain bound.

All successful generation, admission and DRS reservations advance Host state_revision. Failed admission attempts remain charged; no refunds or reset. Installation needs the current revision, same observed package and current catalogue epoch.

Same-task continuation must replace only the absent capability, retain any completed predecessor through the public historical-output binding and use actual guest value in a later PURE Work input/output. The reference demo includes mock effects and cannot be run as the Stage07 application.

Warm discovery is based on mathematical need and scope, with a fresh task/Host, same eligible owning Root identity, actual search/ranking/Root descent and fresh full admission. Serialized packages or old Host authority cannot be restored. Generator count is zero.

Worker limits are 16384 source bytes, at most 256 inputs, at most100000 fuel per input computation and at most30 seconds per worker including startup/compile/trials. One guest computation also creates a worker. Whole-process resource isolation must not be overstated.

The worker invokes exact sys.executable -B -m hedgehog.wasm_pure_worker_v01 with inherited environment. Final source review must bind interpreter, startup/.pth code, module/resource paths, Wasmtime48 distribution metadata/native library, isolated writes and nested process cleanup; no runtime monkeypatch of reference/Popen.

controlled_time_scope.source_fact: Native write_pure_memory_v01 fixes time axes1000, validity1000..2000 and TTL1000; retrieval uses Host evaluation_time and query range1000..3000. No public current-UTC writer parameter exists.
controlled_time_scope.allowed_profile: Fresh invocation-owned store and fresh Hosts; fixed logical cold1014 then warm1015, or an equivalently reviewed increasing finite sequence, with independent actual UTC intake/source freshness and nonrenewed operation deadline.
conditions: Declare controlled logical time in admission, scenario, evidence and final owner report.
